info.title: Oraclebot account and research API
info.description: Wallet-authenticated accounts, durable analysis jobs, finite trading authorizations and subscription lifecycle controls. Customer credentials stay in a separate private executor. Deployment gates independently control billing and trading; source tests do not establish provider acceptance.

post.description: Verify the raw-body Stripe signature and reconcile the canonical subscription Price. Nonterminal events use an owned 30-second per-subscription D1 lease before fetching Stripe. Contention or lost ownership returns HTTP 503 without marking the event handled. Subscription, trial-use and receipt writes require the current unexpired owner. Cancellation events bypass the lease; existing terminal-state protection prevents stale updates restoring canceled access.

session.name: __Host-oraclebot
session.description: 24-hour opaque random token; only SHA-256 token hash is stored. HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/.

agentBearer.description: Opaque resource-bound OAuth token from authorization-code PKCE S256. A browser cookie cannot substitute.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds, future and no more than30days from consent; maxTotalUsd must cover maxTradeUsd.
Unix seconds, future and no more than30days from consent; maxTotalUsd must cover maxTradeUsd.

AgentPolicy.description: Legacy five-field grants permit spot1x only. Version2 explicitly binds products/leverage. USD limits are fee-inclusive notional, including leveraged position notional, not collateral.

privateKey.description: Dedicated Coinbase ECDSA API credential. Never a wallet seed or primary wallet signing key.

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the exact server-issued managed-bot authorization message.

amountDueNowCents.description: Exact gross amount from the verified Stripe invoice preview, including any tax in that quote.

renewalAmountCents.description: Monthly base price. This is not a guaranteed future tax-inclusive invoice total.

trialEnd.description: Original trial end in Unix seconds; plan changes do not extend it.

renewalAmountExcludesTax.description: True when applicable automatic tax is added to the monthly base price.

ExpectedAccount.name: X-Oraclebot-Account
ExpectedAccount.description: Optional browser account-generation fence. Set to the captured authenticated user ID. A mismatch with the cookie principal returns409 account_changed before reading or mutating account state. This header never selects an account or wallet and does not replace authentication. Omit it while discovering the initial session.
